summary: This House Resolution commemorates the 25th anniversary of the Comprehensive Everglades Restoration Plan (CERP), recognizing its bipartisan support and reaffirming the importance of continued commitment to its projects for water quality, ecosystem resilience, and community vitality in Florida.

scores.thoughts: This resolution commemorates the 25th anniversary of the Comprehensive Everglades Restoration Plan (CERP), which is described as a landmark effort to restore, preserve, and protect the South Florida ecosystem. It emphasizes the importance of continued investment in these restoration efforts, directly aligning with environmental protection goals.
